ModMetadata.Name: Protected Areas
ModMetadata.Author: Mooka
ModMetadata.Description: [h1]Protected Areas[/h1] Anti-griefing for public servers. Players claim a 30x30 area around their base; inside it, only authorized players can build, deconstruct, use tools, use devices (doors, levers, valves, switches), take items from containers or mine - similar to the Tool Cupboard in Rust. While the owner is offline, structures inside the area cannot be damaged (explosions, fire, pressure). [h2]Requirements[/h2] BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad. In multiplayer only the host needs the mod; clients that also have it get the red build cursor, blocked tooltips and boundary display. [h2]Usage[/h2] In chat: /area create <name> [radius], /area add <player>, /area del <player>, /area kick, /area remove, /area list, /area info, /area show. In the console (F3): the same commands without the slash (area create base).
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: 1.4.0: - Explosions (grenades, explosives, canisters...) do nothing inside an area or within 10 blocks of it, unless the object belongs to an authorized player 1.3.0: - Trespass warning: unauthorized players get 30 seconds to leave an area, then are moved out or disconnected 1.2.0: - Unauthorized players cannot use doors, levers, valves, switches, slots or containers inside an area - Structures are immune to damage while the area owner is offline - One 30x30 area per player; areas cannot overlap, cannot cover another player's structures and cannot be near spawn - Admins ignore restrictions; 'kick' moves unauthorized players out of an area 1.1.0: - Commands and messages in English - Areas are synced to clients that have the mod 1.0.0: - First version
ModMetadata.InGameDescription: Protected areas: only authorized players can build, use devices or take items inside them. Use /area help in chat or 'area help' in the console (F3).
